source: G. W. F. Hegel: Werke 3, Vorrede (Suhrkamp)

style: 平实白话中文，贴近原文语气，不取学术论文腔；英文为直译式工作译本

en: An explanation of the kind customarily put in front of a book by way of preface — about the purpose the author has set himself in it, and about the occasions and the relation in which he believes it stands to earlier or contemporary treatments of the same subject — seems in the case of a philosophical work not merely superfluous but, by the very nature of the matter, even out of place and contrary to its purpose.

For whatever and however one might properly say about philosophy in a preface — a historical account of its tendency and standpoint, of its general content and results, a joining together of claims and assurances about what is true, made this way and that — cannot count as the way in which philosophical truth is to be presented.

And because philosophy is essentially at home in the element of universality, which includes the particular within itself, the illusion arises with it more than with other sciences that the matter itself, and even its consummate essence, is already expressed in the purpose or in the final results, while the execution is really the inessential part.

In ordinary thinking, by contrast — say of what anatomy is, namely the knowledge of the parts of the body considered in their lifeless existence — one is convinced that one does not yet possess the matter itself, the content of this science, and that one must besides take pains with the particular.

– Moreover, in such an aggregate of information, which does not rightly bear the name of a science, talk about purpose and similar generalities tends to be no different from the historical, conceptless way in which the content itself — these nerves, muscles and so on — is spoken of.
In philosophy, on the other hand, the inconsistency would arise that such a manner is used and yet is shown by philosophy itself to be incapable of grasping the truth.
zh: 一本书照例要在序言里先作个交代——讲作者在书里给自己定的目的，讲写作的缘起，讲它跟前人、跟同时代人对同一问题所做的处理是什么关系——，可是在一本哲学书里，这种交代不只是多余，按事情本身的性质说，甚至并不合适，还有违初衷。
因为在一篇序言里，关于哲学无论怎么说、说什么才算得体——比如讲一讲它的倾向和立场、一般的内容和结果，把关于真理的各种主张和保证这边那边地摆在一处——，都不能算作哲学真理该有的表述方式。
又因为哲学本质上是在普遍性这个元素里活动，而普遍性本身包含着特殊，所以在哲学这里，比在别的科学那里更容易生出一种假象：仿佛目的或者最后的结果已经把事情本身、甚至把它完整的样子都说出来了，而真正的展开反倒成了无关紧要的东西。
反过来看一般人的表象：比如解剖学是什么？就是把身体的各个部分当作没有生命的东西来认识。谁都知道，光凭这个还没有真正掌握事情本身、没有掌握这门学问的内容，此外还得去下功夫琢磨那些具体的东西。
——再说，在这样一堆知识里（它并不配叫科学），人们谈目的以及诸如此类的空泛话题，往往跟谈内容本身（这些神经、肌肉之类）时那种只讲事实、不讲概念的方式并没有什么两样。
可到了哲学这里就会自相矛盾：一边用着这种办法，一边哲学自己又指出，这种办法根本抓不住真理。

en: In the same way, by defining the relation a philosophical work believes it has to other efforts at the same subject, an alien interest is drawn in and what matters in the knowledge of truth is obscured.

However firmly ordinary opinion holds to the opposition of true and false, it likewise expects either agreement or contradiction with regard to an existing philosophical system, and in a statement about such a system it sees only the one or the other.
It does not so much grasp the diversity of philosophical systems as the progressive development of truth, since in that diversity it sees only contradiction.

The bud disappears when the blossom breaks out, and one could say that the former is refuted by the latter; in the same way the blossom is declared by the fruit to be a false existence of the plant, and the fruit steps into the blossom's place as its truth.
These forms not only differ from one another, they also displace one another as incompatible.

But their fluid nature makes them at the same time moments of the organic unity, in which they not only do not contradict one another, but the one is as necessary as the other, and this equal necessity is what first makes up the life of the whole.

But contradiction directed at a philosophical system tends partly not to understand itself in this way, and partly the comprehending consciousness generally does not know how to free it from its one-sidedness, or to keep it free, and to recognize in the shape of what appears to fight and oppose itself mutually necessary moments.
zh: 同样，一本哲学书一旦去界定自己跟别人在同一题目上的努力是什么关系，就引进了一种不相干的兴趣，把认识真理中真正要紧的东西弄模糊了。
一般人把真和假的对立看得越死，就越指望你对一个现成的哲学体系要么赞成、要么反对；而在关于这个体系的说法里，他也只看得到这两样中的一样。
各种哲学体系之间的差别，它并不怎么理解为真理在一步步展开，因为在它眼里，差别就只等于互相矛盾。
花蕾在花朵绽开时消失了，也可以说，花蕾被花朵否定了；同样，果实又把花朵说成植物的一种虚假存在，果实取代花朵，成了它的真理。
这些形态不只是彼此不同，它们还互不相容，互相排挤。
但它们那种流动的本性，同时又把它们变成有机统一体的环节：在这里，它们不但不互相打架，反而每一个都跟另一个同样必要；正是这种同等的必要，才构成了整体的生命。
可是针对某个哲学体系的反对意见，一来往往并不这样以概念把握自己，二来具有理解力的意识通常也不知道怎样把这种反对意见从片面性里解放出来、或者让它保持不片面，不知道要在那副互相争斗、彼此对立的样子里认出双方其实是彼此必需的环节。

en: The demand for explanations of this kind, and the satisfactions given to it, easily pass for attending to what is essential.

Where could the inner core of a philosophical work be more plainly stated than in its purposes and results, and how could these be known more precisely than through their difference from whatever else the age produces in the same sphere?

But if such a procedure is to count for more than the beginning of knowing, if it is to pass for actual knowing, then it is in fact to be counted among the inventions for getting around the matter itself and combining the two: the appearance of seriousness and effort about it, and the actual saving of that effort,

– for the matter is not exhausted in its purpose but in its execution, nor is the result the actual whole, but the result together with its becoming; the purpose on its own is the lifeless universal, just as the tendency is mere drive, which still lacks its actuality, and the bare result is the corpse that the tendency has left behind it.
– In the same way, difference is rather the boundary of the matter; it is there where the matter stops, or it is what the matter is not.
Such labours with the purpose or the results, and with the differences and judgements of the one and the other, are therefore easier work than they may seem.

For instead of occupying itself with the matter, such activity is always beyond it; instead of lingering in it and forgetting itself in it, such knowing always reaches for something else and stays rather with itself than with the matter, giving itself over to it.
– The easiest thing is to judge what has substance and solidity; harder, to grasp it; hardest, to produce its presentation, which unites both.
zh: 要求这种交代、并且给出这种交代，很容易被当成是在做要紧的事。
一本哲学书的内在东西，还有比它的目的和结果说得更明白的地方吗？而要更确切地认识这些东西，除了拿它们跟同时代在同一领域里产生的别的东西作比较，还能有什么办法？
可是，如果这种做法要算作比认识的开始更多的东西，要算作现实的认识，那它其实就该归到这样一类发明里去：绕开事情本身，同时又把两样东西合在一起——表面上认真、肯为它下功夫，实际上把功夫省掉了，
——因为事情并不在目的里就完了，而是在它的实行里；结果也不是现实的整体，结果连同它的生成才是。目的单凭自己只是没有生命的普遍，倾向也只是还缺着现实性的单纯冲动，而光秃秃的结果则是倾向丢在身后的尸体。
——同样，差别其实是事情的界限所在：它在事情停止的地方，或者说，它就是事情所不是的那个东西。
所以，围绕目的或结果、围绕这一个和那一个的差别与评价所下的这番功夫，其实比看上去要省力。
因为这种做法不是在跟事情打交道，而总是跑到事情外面去；它不是留在事情里、把自己忘在事情里，而总是伸手去抓别的东西，始终待在自己那儿，而不是待在事情那儿、把自己交给事情。
——最容易的是对有内容、有分量的东西下判断；比较难的是理解它；最难的是把两者合在一起，把它的表述做出来。

en: The beginning of culture and of working one's way out of the immediacy of substantial life will always have to be made by acquiring knowledge of general principles and points of view, by struggling up at first only to the thought of the matter in general, and no less by supporting or refuting it with reasons, by grasping the concrete and rich fullness according to its determinations, and by knowing how to give orderly information and serious judgement about it.

But this beginning of culture will first have to give way to the seriousness of a full life, which leads into the experience of the matter itself; and even if there is added to this the seriousness of the concept descending into its depths, such knowledge and judgement will still keep its proper place in conversation.
zh: 要受教育、要从实体性生活的那种直接状态里挣扎出来，开头总得这么走：先去掌握一般的原则和观点，先费力爬到对事情的一般思想那儿；同样也要学会用理由去支持它或反驳它，学会按各种规定去把握那具体而丰富的内容，并且懂得对它作出有条理的说明和认真的判断。
不过，这种受教育的开头，先要让位给充实生活里的那份认真，因为正是它把人领进对事情本身的体验；就算再加上概念的认真、一直深入到事情的深处，这类知识和判断在闲谈里也还是会有它合适的位置。

en: The true shape in which truth exists can only be the scientific system of truth.
To help bring philosophy closer to the form of science — to the goal of being able to lay aside the name of love of knowing and to be actual knowing — that is what I have set myself to do.
The inner necessity that knowing be science lies in its nature, and the only satisfactory explanation of this is the presentation of philosophy itself.

External necessity, however, taken in a general way, apart from the contingency of the person and of individual occasions, is the same as the inner one, namely in the shape in which time presents the existence of its moments.

To show that the elevation of philosophy to science is timely would therefore be the only true justification of the attempts that have this purpose, since it would demonstrate its necessity — indeed, it would at the same time carry it out.
zh: 真理存在的真正形态，只能是真理的科学体系。
让哲学更接近科学的形式——接近那个目标：可以卸下“爱知识”这个名字，成为现实的知识——这就是我给自己定下的事。
知识必须是科学，这种内在的必然性就在知识的本性里；而要对此作出令人满意的说明，唯一的办法就是把哲学本身表述出来。
至于外在的必然性，只要撇开个人的偶然和个别的缘由、从一般的方式来理解，它就跟内在的必然性是同一回事，只不过采取了时间呈现其各个环节存在的那种形态。
所以，要指出把哲学提升为科学正当其时，这才是为抱有这个目的的那些努力所作的唯一的真正辩护：因为它会说明这件事的必然性，甚至同时就把这件事做出来了。

en: In setting the true shape of truth in this scientific character — or, what comes to the same, in claiming that truth has the element of its existence in the concept alone — I know that this seems to stand in contradiction with a way of thinking, and with its consequences, which is as widespread in the convictions of the age as it is presumptuous.
An explanation of this contradiction therefore does not seem superfluous, even if here it can be nothing more than an assurance, just like the one it opposes.

For if the true exists only in, or rather only as, what is now called intuition, now immediate knowledge of the absolute, religion, being — not in the centre of divine love, but the being of that centre itself — then from that side the very opposite of the form of the concept is demanded for the presentation of philosophy.
The absolute is not to be comprehended but felt and intuited; not its concept but its feeling and intuition are to have the say and to be expressed.
zh: 把真理的真正形态放在这种科学性里——或者说，同样一件事：主张真理只有在概念里才有它存在的元素——我知道，这看起来跟一种表象及其后果是矛盾的，而这种表象在同时代的信念里流传得有多广，它就有多自负。
所以，对这个矛盾作个说明看来并不多余，即便它在这里也只能是一个保证，跟它所针对的那个保证一样。
因为，如果真只存在于——或者说只作为——那样一种东西，它一会儿被叫作直观，一会儿被叫作对绝对者的直接知识、宗教、存在（不是指神性的爱这个中心，而是指这个中心本身的存在），那么从这一边出发，对哲学的表述所要求的恰恰是概念形式的反面。
绝对者不该被概念地把握，而该被感受、被直观；该说话、该被说出来的，不是它的概念，而是对它的感受和直观。

en: If the appearance of such a demand is grasped in its more general context and seen at the stage on which self-conscious spirit presently stands, then spirit has gone beyond the substantial life it otherwise led in the element of thought — beyond this immediacy of its faith, beyond the satisfaction and security of the certainty that consciousness possessed of its reconciliation with the essence and with the latter's universal, inner and outer, presence.
It has not only gone beyond that into the other extreme of the substanceless reflection of itself into itself, but beyond this as well.
Its essential life is not only lost to it; it is also conscious of this loss and of the finitude that is its content.

Turning away from the husks, confessing that it lies in evil and railing at it, it now demands of philosophy not so much knowledge of what it is, as rather that through philosophy it may first arrive again at the restoration of that substantiality and of the solidity of being.

So philosophy is to satisfy this need not so much by unlocking the closedness of substance and raising it to self-consciousness, not so much by bringing chaotic consciousness back to thought-out order and to the simplicity of the concept, as rather by pouring the distinctions of thought together, suppressing the distinguishing concept and producing the feeling of the essence, granting not so much insight as edification.

The beautiful, the holy, the eternal, religion and love are the bait that is demanded in order to awaken the desire to bite; not the concept but ecstasy, not the coldly advancing necessity of the matter but fermenting enthusiasm, is to be the bearing and the onward-leading unfolding of the wealth of substance.
zh: 如果把这样一种要求的出现放到它更大的关联里去看，放在自我意识着的精神目前所处的阶段上去看，那么这种精神已经走出了它原先在思想元素里过的那种实体性生活——走出了它信仰的那种直接性，也走出了意识曾经拥有的那种满足和确信：确信自己已经跟本质、跟本质那普遍的、内在与外在的在场和解了。
它不光是走出了那一步、落进自身之内那种没有实体的反思这个另一极端，而且还走出了这个极端。
它不只是失去了自己本质性的生命；它还对这种失去、对构成它内容的那种有限性有所意识。
它转身离开那些糠壳，承认自己陷在恶里，并为此痛骂；现在它向哲学要求的，与其说是知自己是什么，不如说是要借哲学重新达到那种实体性和存在的坚实。
所以，哲学要满足这种需要，与其说该去打开实体的封闭、把它提升为自我意识，与其说该把混乱的意识带回到被思考的秩序和概念的单纯性，不如说该把思想的各种区分一股脑倒在一起，压制那个作区分的概念，制造出对本质的感受——给人的与其说是洞见，不如说是感化。
美、神圣、永恒、宗教和爱，都是用来招人上钩的诱饵；该充当实体的丰富内容之承载和绵延展开的，不是概念，而是迷狂；不是事情那种冷静推进的必然性，而是发酵般的热情。
